observations.finding: These carry support/column identifiers such as 21, 22, 23, 24 and dimensions.
The same unnumbered dimensioned rectangles recur along multiple beam lines and therefore behave as section/beam-section annotations rather than uniquely identifiable supports.

retractions.reason: No legible 22-prime label has been demonstrated.
The adjacent 20x50 rectangle is more consistent with a repeated beam-section annotation symbol than a numbered column/support.

new_hypothesis.statement: A' may be a non-column frame node: a beam/load/geometric transition point introduced in the calculation model between column/support lines.
new_hypothesis.c6_effect: C6 = Z-A' may be a short beam sub-segment ending at a non-support transition node; this naturally explains why it can appear in the frame calculation while lacking a second numbered pillar in plan.
